agent_explanation: Single ball dropped from y=3.4 with e=1 bounces off arena floor between steps 24 and 25. Incoming speed 7.25 m/s becomes outgoing 8.62 m/s, so kinetic + potential energy jumps from ~32.95 J to 42.34 J with zero controller work, exceeding E0+10%+5. With e=1 the bounce should at most preserve speed. Likely cause: floor impulse and/or positional correction adds energy when resolving deep penetration accumulated over large dt=0.0308 substeps, injecting net energy instead of reflecting velocity.
